name: Phosphor Slipstream
description: The strip leg of the official Phosphor set. While the strip scrolls, glowing signal lanes light up across it and bright gradient pulses race along them, overtaking the content in the direction of travel. Highlights in the content throw comet tails behind the motion and ember sparks drift in the wake. Everything scales with scroll speed and vanishes as the strip settles.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Trail Intensity
parameters.description: How bright the gradient trails glow at a given scroll speed.

parameters.name: Trail Length
parameters.description: How far the trails stream out behind the moving columns.

parameters.name: Signal Lanes
parameters.description: How many signal lanes cross the strip.

parameters.name: Embers
parameters.description: How many ember sparks drift in the wake.
